meta.name: Meet Cute
meta.description: Meet Cute takes you through five instances of Two strangers, unexpectedly, find solace in each other’s company while navigating through tricky phases in their lives, helping them look at themselves and their loved ones in a different light.

videos.title: Meet the Boy
videos.overview: An independent Swathi is forced by her mother to meet ‘dude no 11’ aka Abhi for dinner. He might look sweet and be chivalrous but she’s wary of anyone who seems too good to be true.
